arguments.subject: Anya workshop recording: scope of signed license
arguments.body:
Under the signed limited-use agreement, North Pier was licensed to use one edited version of Anya’s workshop recording, no longer than 45 minutes, in North Pier’s public resource library for 12 months. The agreement allowed editorial cuts to make that bounded edit; it did not authorize use of the full recording or separate social-media clips. Publication required Anya’s written approval of the final edit and her caption review. She approved the specific 44:38 edit and captions—not later alterations.

That 12-month license has expired, and Anya later required the recording’s removal; North Pier confirmed permanent removal in September 2027. North Pier therefore may not use or republish the recording now under that agreement. Any new use would require a new license.
